parsed.scene_description: The image shows an empty warehouse with multiple levels of storage. The floor is made of concrete and the walls are painted white. On the right side of the image, there are several large metal cages stacked on top of each other. The cages are of different sizes and colors, including blue, red, and green. In the center of the room, there is a forklift with a red handle. The forklift is moving through the cages, and there are cardboard boxes and pallets scattered around the room. The room appears to be well-lit with fluorescent lights on the ceiling.
